notes.title: New features in version v1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Special buttons allowing quick selection of crops and food
[*]Information about the number of occupied spaces compared to the total population
[*]Information on how many player units are currently on the map (visible in the production window)
[*]Changes making the Tutorial easier
[*]Minor interface adjustments
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]
